clusters.headline: US Envoys Engage In Russia Talks As Starlink Disruption Occurs
aiSummaryBullets: United States envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff held discussions with Vladimir Putin in Moscow following earlier negotiations in Abu Dhabi.
Ukrainian officials reported significant disruptions to Starlink satellite services amid the ongoing diplomatic efforts.

clusters.headline: Russia Launches Large-Scale Airstrikes Against Ukrainian Energy Grid
aiSummaryBullets: Russian forces deployed over 170 drones and 36 missiles in attacks across the Kyiv region.
The strikes targeted key electricity infrastructure and a bridge spanning the Dnipro River.
